Maîtriser le premier losange de Mécaniqu: Master the first diamond of Mechanics.
En 1999, la sonde Mars Climate Orbiter s: In 1999, the Mars Climate Orbiter probe was lost in the atmosphere of Mars. One piece of software gave its values in pound-force·seconds, another read them in newton·seconds.
Maîtriser les ordres de grandeur. Vous p: Master orders of magnitude. You can now say what can be seen from space, and what can't.
La Grande Muraille n'est pas visible à l: The Great Wall is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon, nor even easily from low orbit: it's long, but narrow and the color of the ground. Yang Liwei, the first Chinese astronaut, said in 2003 that he hadn't seen it.
Maîtriser les ondes et la lumière. Ne me: Master waves and light. Don't set any fleet on fire.
Archimède aurait incendié la flotte roma: Archimedes supposedly set the Roman fleet on fire with mirrors. The story only appears centuries later. In 2005, MIT students managed to ignite a stationary ship model, in strong sunshine, after about ten minutes.
Maîtriser les forces et le mouvement. Le: Master forces and motion. Astronauts don't float: they fall, without ever hitting the ground.
À 400 km d'altitude, là où tourne la Sta: At 400 km up, where the Space Station orbits, gravity is still 90% of what it is on the ground. If astronauts float, it's because they're constantly falling around the Earth, along with their station, at 28,000 km/h. They miss the ground, on every orbit.
Maîtriser l'énergie. Inutile de m'envoye: Master energy. No need to send me the plans for your machine.
En 1775, l'Académie royale des sciences: In 1775, the Royal Academy of Sciences in Paris decided to stop examining any perpetual motion machine, or any squaring of the circle. It received too many, all wrong, and the inventors never gave up. Energy is conserved: nothing spins for free.
Maîtriser la pression et les fluides. L': Master pressure and fluids. The air on top has no appointment with the air underneath.
Une explication répandue dit que l'air p: A common explanation says that the air passing over the wing must meet the air underneath at the same time, so it goes faster. That's false: it even arrives well before. The wing flies because it deflects air downward, and the pressure difference follows from that.
Maîtriser la chaleur et la thermodynamiq: Master heat and thermodynamics. The answer is: it depends, and that's already a lot.
En 1963, Erasto Mpemba, lycéen tanzanien: In 1963, Erasto Mpemba, a Tanzanian schoolboy, notices that his hot ice-cream mix sets faster than his classmates'. His teachers laugh. A physicist published the effect with him in 1969. Since then, experiments have contradicted each other: in 2016, a careful study found no effect.
Maîtriser la relativité. Sans elle, vous: Master relativity. Without it, you'd be ten kilometers off every day.
Les horloges des satellites GPS avancent: GPS satellite clocks run about 38 microseconds a day ahead of those on the ground: weaker gravity speeds them up, their velocity slows them down. Without relativistic correction, the position error would grow by about ten kilometers every day.
Maîtriser la physique quantique. Planck: Master quantum physics. Planck didn't believe it himself. You're in good company.
En 1900, Max Planck découpe l'énergie de: In 1900, Max Planck cuts the energy of light into small packets, quanta, to make a formula fit the measurements. He doesn't believe it. Thirty years later, he writes that it was “an act of desperation”, done because an explanation had to be found, at any cost.
Réussir trois quiz de Mécanique sans fau: Pass three Mechanics quizzes without a mistake. You don't weigh much, but you weigh right.
En 1798, Henry Cavendish, savant si timi: In 1798, Henry Cavendish, a scientist so shy that he communicated with his servants by notes, hangs lead balls in a shed and measures their tiny attraction. From it he deduces the density of the Earth, to within one percent.
Maîtriser les machines simples. Le levie: Master simple machines. The lever, the pulley, and now you. The AI remains sceptical about the last one.
Vers 1600, Simon Stevin embarque le prin: Around 1600, Simon Stevin took Prince Maurice of Nassau and twenty-six other passengers aboard a sailing carriage, on the beach between Scheveningen and Petten. Driven by the wind alone, it went faster than horses.
Maîtriser le mouvement selon Aristote. V: Master motion according to Aristotle. You now know why the void is impossible. Almost.
Aristote refusait le vide par un raisonn: Aristotle rejected the void by reasoning: falling speed depends on the density of the medium, so, with no medium, a body would move infinitely fast and fill the void at once. In 1643, Torricelli made one at the top of a mercury tube.
Maîtriser les ingénieurs d'Alexandrie. D: Master the engineers of Alexandria. Two thousand years of vending machines, and still no change given.
Héron décrit un appareil qui, contre une: Hero described a device that, for a coin, poured a fixed amount of water for ablutions. He also described temple doors that opened by themselves when the altar fire was lit.
Maîtriser la physique des Mohistes. Vous: Master Mohist physics. You avoided a war without leaving your chair. Mozi had walked ten days.
Pour sauver le petit État de Song, Mozi: To save the small state of Song, Mozi faced the engineer Gongshu Ban before the king of Chu, in nine simulated sieges, and won all nine. Threatened, he warned that his disciples had already trained Song's defenders. The king gave up the war.
Maîtriser l'optique d'Ibn al-Haytham. Il: Master Ibn al-Haytham's optics. He pretended to be mad to be left in peace. The AI knows the method.
Chargé par le calife al-Hakim de dompter: Tasked by the caliph al-Hakim with taming the Nile floods, Ibn al-Haytham realised on site that his dam was impossible. He feigned madness and, legend says, stayed shut away at home until the caliph's death, in 1021. He used the time to write his Book of Optics.
Maîtriser l'impetus médiéval. Entre deux: Master medieval impetus. Between two answers, you chose. The ass is still waiting.
L'âne de Buridan, qui meurt de faim entr: Buridan's ass, which starves between two bales of hay for want of choosing, appears in no known work of Buridan. In his commentary on Aristotle's On the Heavens, it is a dog that hesitates between two meals.
Maîtriser verres et lunettes. Vous voyez: Master lenses and spectacles. You see further. The AI saw you coming.
Le 2 octobre 1608, Hans Lipperhey demand: On 2 October 1608, Hans Lipperhey applied for a patent on an instrument "for seeing things far away as if they were nearby". Refused: other spectacle makers claimed to have invented it too. According to one of the stories in circulation, the idea came to him when he saw two children playing with lenses in his shop.
Maîtriser Galilée et la chute. Vous n'av: Master Galileo and falling. You dropped nothing from the top of a tower. Probably neither did Galileo.
Selon son élève Viviani, Galilée aurait: According to his pupil Viviani, Galileo dropped weights from the Tower of Pisa between 1589 and 1592. Galileo never mentions it. In 1586, at Delft, Simon Stevin and Jan Cornets de Groot really did drop two lead balls, one ten times heavier than the other: they hit the ground together.
Maîtriser Huygens et le pendule. Votre h: Master Huygens and the pendulum. Your clock is right, provided you don't board a ship.
Huygens rêvait d'horloges qui donneraien: Huygens dreamed of clocks that would give longitude at sea. In 1660, the trial voyage to Spain was ruined by heavy weather; a French trial at Cayenne ended badly. The ship's motion upsets the pendulum: other mechanisms would be needed to solve the problem.
Maîtriser la mesure de la lumière. Trois: Master measuring light. Three centuries to gain a few decimals. It took you one evening.
Albert Michelson passa sa vie à mesurer: Albert Michelson spent his life measuring the speed of light. He died in 1931 in the middle of a last series, in a vacuum tube 1.6 km long, with 36 series of measurements done out of 233. Why so much effort? "Because it's so much fun," he reputedly replied.
Maîtriser la grande science. Des millier: Master big science. Thousands of researchers, billions of euros, and you. The AI files you under details.
Le surnom « particule de Dieu » vient du: The nickname "God particle" comes from Leon Lederman's popular book, The God Particle, published in 1993. The press loved it; physicists, Peter Higgs first among them, much less so.
Le corniste du train: The horn player on the train
Maîtriser les ondes et la lumière. Vous: Master waves and light. You can finally hear the siren change its note. The AI never changes her tone.
Le 3 juin 1845, le Néerlandais Buys Ball: On 3 June 1845, the Dutchman Buys Ballot put a horn player on a steam train between Utrecht and Maarssen. Listeners with good ears, on the train and on the platforms, listened to the note: the aim was to test the effect described by Doppler in 1842.
